rows: No street address, APN or parcel identifier supplied
Every parcel-specific value (hazard zone, zoning, AADT, tax rate area, comps, tract trend) must remain blank and unverified.
No lease document; expiry supplied only as the range 2030-2035
Rent, escalations, options, notice deadlines, co-tenancy, assignment, ROFR and holdover cannot be verified.
No owner financials, basis, purchase date, depreciation schedule or loan terms
No after-tax dollar result can be published; only verified mechanics and a browser-only calculator are offered.
No verified arm's-length short-lease QSR quote set
The short-lease discount cannot be priced; no number is published or inferred.
"Central Los Angeles" is not a Census geography
City/county figures are proxies; a fixed tract set is required before W-01 / W-12 values can attach to this parcel.
Repository initially contained only a 10-byte project-title placeholder
No source register, privacy notice, licence or dataset existed for a line-by-line review.
Five other Arena session branches claimed overlapping site scopes
All this session's content is isolated under `web/**` so no other session's files are overwritten; Pages source settings are left unchanged.
Census QuickFacts mixes vintages (V2025 estimates, 2020-2024 ACS, 2022 Economic Census)
Census warns that different vintage years of estimates are not comparable; each row pins its own vintage and unit.
BLS and EDD October 2026 figures are preliminary
Values are published with the preliminary flag and must be re-checked before a sale or renewal commitment.
2026 SRA Fire Hazard Severity Zone public comment period is open (Nov 9, 2026 - Jan 8, 2027)
A future zone designation may differ from the current effective map; no parcel status is asserted.
Census API key required for tract-level ACS pulls
Tract-level trend evidence cannot be fetched anonymously in this public workflow; no tract value is published.
SEC operator data are systemwide, not the subject unit
National same-store sales, closures and franchise rental revenues are direction only; unit-level rent coverage remains unverified.
CDI insurance figures are statewide homeowner averages/counts
They are context, not quotes for a commercial NNN property; no property premium is asserted.
SCAG projections are assumptions-based and subregional uncertainty is higher
Forecast values are labelled projections, never observations; 2030-2035 parcel employment is blank.
No sufficient verified comparable history for a back-test
A versioned, back-tested cash-flow model is not published and no sell/hold winner is selected.
Caltrans AADT data cover the State Highway System only
City/county street counts come from the local agency; frontage AADT is blank until the road is identified.
CCPA excludes publicly available property records from 'personal information'
This site nevertheless publishes no APN, address, lease file or owner financials, regardless of that exclusion.
California and federal capital-gain thresholds differ by year and filing status
2025 and 2026 thresholds are published separately; the calculator requires the correct tax year and private taxable income.
